senses.nuances: 此处马来语释义为编写者说明，并非 DBP 官方释文。UNICEF 说明 Meena 是南亚常见名字，也用于其儿童教育角色；这不能证明输入专指该角色。以下称谓组合为用法示例，未作搭配频率认定。[UNICEF：Meena and UNICEF](https://www.unicef.org/bangladesh/en/meena-and-unicef)

etymology.historical_story: Meena is a personal name with a documented cultural presence in South Asia. UNICEF chose it for an animated girl whose stories address education, equality and children's rights. This provides cultural context, rather than a verified etymology for the supplied token: without its original language, script or referent, assigning a single historical meaning would be speculative. [UNICEF: Meena and UNICEF](https://www.unicef.org/bangladesh/en/meena-and-unicef)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Meena，先联想一个名叫“米娜”的人；把它作为完整姓名记忆，读音以本人确认为准。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正文中的人名应大写为 Meena。登记姓名时保留本人使用的拼写，不擅自改成 Mina 或其他形式；输入不足以指定某位真实人物。
